Hi Soojin / Redwood team —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We’re ready to move forward with portal enrollment (Coupa) but have a couple of practical gating items from our procurement and finance teams before we can finish registration: 

- PO prefix: Our ERP requires a PO prefix for inbound POs (US-MED-). Can Redwood include that exact prefix on supplier-side POs?
- Invoice routing: AP wants invoices sent to ap@medaline.com and prefers the GL code on each invoice line item. Can you confirm the invoice email and whether line-level GLs are accepted?
- Payment terms: Our treasury is asking to move to Net45 instead of Net30 for enterprise vendors — would Redwood accept Net45 for the initial term?

Attached is our redlined version of the Order Form with a few small edits (pricing clarified, billing contact). Also looping Legal Ops (cc) for the MSA redline.

Attachments:
- Medaline_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (PDF, 72KB)

Best,

Alex — thanks for the redline and clear list. Quick summary / asks from our side so we can get procurement portal activation scheduled: 

1) PO prefix: We can map incoming POs and preserve a vendor-side prefix. Need confirmation if the prefix is mandatory on every PO number or only on certain procurement categories. Can you confirm?

2) Invoice routing: We accept invoices to ap@redwood-invoices.com (our standard ingestion) and can forward to your AP team as part of the enrollment. If Medaline requires the GL code on the invoice line, can you confirm whether GLs will be provided in the Coupa order payload or only on emailed invoices? That impacts our mapping.

3) Payment terms: Net45 is outside our standard Net30; I will flag this with finance (ccing Vivek for approvals). If we need an exception it generally requires finance sign-off and may add a ~5 business day delay to final execution.

Laura — can you take the attached order form + MSA redline and call out any high-risk language we should push back on (DPA, termination for convenience, liability caps)? If there are non-starters, please list bullet edits we want.

I can do a 30-minute alignment call Monday 9am PT if that works for everyone.

Thanks — placing this on my calendar pending confirmation.

— Soojin
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Soojin / team — I reviewed the Medaline Order Form and the MSA redline they provided. High-level comments below and an attached tracked-changes doc with inline notes.

Top legal items: 
- DPA: Medaline added a DPA reference but left the processor/sub-processor flow ambiguous. We need a clear statement that Redwood remains the processor for inference API calls and that subprocessor notice will be provided 30 days prior to onboarding any new subprocessors.
- Liability & indemnity: Their redline reduces our liability cap below standard. Recommend we restore mutual liability cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months.
- Termination & data return: Add explicit export window (30 days) and confirmation of KV cache persistence policies.

If Medaline will accept the three edits above we can proceed without escalation; if they refuse the DPA or liability language we should escalate to legal counsel for negotiation.

Attachment: MSA_redline_laura_comments.docx (DOCX, 26KB)

Marissa — can you validate if the portal supports delivery of the order form metadata (GL codes per line) to our billing ingestion? If not, we should surface that as a technical gating item to their procurement team.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
